notes.title: Lakshya Sen's block was their biggest weapon
notes.body: 6 of their 23 outright winners came from the block. Expect it — and train the counter.

notes.title: The “net shot → net shot” exchange favored Lee Zii Jia
notes.body: This ending sequence appeared 8 times and Lee Zii Jia took 6 of them. Recognize the setup shot and break the pattern early.

notes.title: Lakshya Sen owned the big points
notes.body: From 18+ in a game, Lakshya Sen took 8 of the 12 points. Composure under pressure decided the tight stretches.
